title: Template Studio
lead: A section for template authors: edit document templates and propose changes. The git host decides on merging.

enabled.title: Section is on
enabled.hintOn: People with access see “Template Studio” in the header.
enabled.hintOff: Template Studio is off: people do not get the header button.
enabled.locked: The switch is set when the server starts and cannot be changed here.

access.title: Who can edit templates
access.hintTodo: Nobody yet. Administrators always have access.

repo.title: Repository for sending changes
repo.hintTodo: Without it, each author sends changes with their own git access, for example from their fork.
repo.hintError: Could not find out whether repositories are connected. The list below shows the reason.

grants.title: Who can edit templates
grants.lead: People and organization groups who can open Template Studio. New group members get access automatically.
grants.emptyLead: Grant access to yourself or to a group of methodists.

grant.title: Grant access to Template Studio
grant.lead: To a person or a whole organization group: new group members get access automatically.

service.title: Connected repositories
service.lead: Template repositories the service sends changes to on its own behalf. The author of each change is still the person. A repository is connected once.
service.emptyLead: Without them, each author sends changes with their own git access. Connect a repository so the service does it.
service.removeLead: Workspaces that send changes through it lose access to the repository.
service.addLead: The token is stored encrypted and never shown again. Every use is written to the audit log.
service.label: Name
service.labelHint: How the repository is named in the list. Empty: the path from the address.
service.tokenHint: https only. Needs rights: write to the repository, pull requests, checks status.

problem.token_rejected: GitHub did not accept the token: it is revoked, expired or mistyped.
problem.cannot_push: The token has no write access to the repository: the service cannot send changes.
problem.provider_unsupported: The check only works for GitHub.

official.title: Official templates
official.lead: People propose changes to the official HSE templates from their own GitHub account: changes go to their copy of the repository (a fork), and the merge request is opened in their name.
official.hidden: No official repository is set, so Template Studio has no “Official templates” button. To add it, set the address in HSE_STUDIO__PACK_STUDIO__OFFICIAL_REPO_URL.
